purpose: edict specifying traditional allocations and customary payments (maryādā) on occasions of royal favor (rājaprasāda) to shrines, officials, gates, and attendants
notes: Issued from Kailāsakūṭabhavana by Mahāsāmanta Aṃśuvarman with svayam-ājñā (no separate dūtaka). The inscription lists amounts in paṇa and purāṇa due to deities, royal emblems, and numerous offices/attendants (mahābalādhyakṣa, prasādādhikṛta, bhāṇḍanāyaka, etc.), none of whom are named individually.
